```{r - Screenmedia's Data About Netflix, Hulu, and Disney}
      description = "The revenue for the streaming service in 2024. Listed in the bar chart right of the blue bar. Separate each revenue into a new row. EX: 243.8."

  )
))
```

```{r - Top platforms by ad spending}

ad_spend <- chat$chat_structured(
  ellmer::content_image_file("../Data/project_images/adtechradar_ad_spending.png"),
  type = ellmer::type_array(ellmer::type_object(
    Platform = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The name of each of the 10 streaming services listed in the chart. Separate each service into a new row. EX: Disney+"
    ),
    `2024 Ad Spending (Millions)` = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The ad spend for the streaming service from 2024 and 2025. Listed in the  chart under the 2024 column name, to the right of each service. Separate each revenue into a new row.  EX: 4386",
    required = FALSE
    ), 
    `2025 Ad Spending (Millions)` = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The ad spend for the streaming service from 2024 and 2025. Listed in the  chart under the 2025 column name, to the right of each service. Separate each revenue into a new row. EX: 4690",
    required = FALSE
    ),
    `Ad Spending % Change` = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The change in ad spending from 2025 to 2024 for each streaming service. Listed in the chart under the % change column. Change the percentage to a decimal EX: 7% = 0.07", required = FALSE
    )
  )
))

ad_spend

```

```{r CAGR over Time}

CAGR <- chat$chat_structured(
  ellmer::content_image_file("../Data/project_images/statista_CAGR_overT.png"),
  type = ellmer::type_array(ellmer::type_object(
    Platform = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The name of each of the 6 streaming services listed in the bar chart. Separate each service into a new row. EX: Paramount+"
    ),
    `Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) (%)` = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "The CAGR for the streaming service. Listed in the bar chart above the blue bar. Separate each revenue into a new row. Write this number without the percent symbol. Change the percentage to a decimal EX: 37% = 0.37"
    )
  )
))

CAGR
```

```{r}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(
  paths = "/how-many-ads-does-each-streaming-service-show", #The first path after the domain that we want to access
  domain = "https://thestreamable.com"
  
)


webpage <- rvest::read_html("https://thestreamable.com/how-many-ads-does-each-streaming-service-show")

webpage |>
  rvest::html_elements("#content > article > div.markdown-body.width-fit.draft-current-text > table") |>
  rvest::html_table() -> all_tables

all_tables

big_table = dplyr::left_join(all_tables[[1]], all_tables[[2]], by = c('Streamer', 'Original Article'))
big_table = dplyr::left_join(big_table, all_tables[[3]], by = c('Streamer', 'Original Article'))

big_table

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

big_table <- reduce(
  all_tables,
  left_join,
  by = c("Streamer", "Original Article")
)

names(big_table
      )

big_table <- big_table |> dplyr::select(-`Original Article`)

big_table <- big_table |> rename(Platform = Streamer)

big_table[[2]] |> as.list() -> prompts

prompts

ep_breaks <- ellmer::type_object( #create a type thing (used by ellmer)
  #time to record what we want to extract specifically 
  `Pre-roll breaks per 30 min episode` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "Whether the streaming service has ads during the pre-roll or not. EX: No pre-roll "
  ),
  `Minimum breaks per 30 min episode` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "The minimum number of breaks during an episode. Represented in the list as number to number breaks during. Pick the smaller number. EX: 2"
  ),
  `Maximum breaks per 30 min episode` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "The maximum number of breaks during an episode. Represented in the list as number to number breaks during. Pick the larger number. EX: 6", required = FALSE
  )
)

ep_breaks_extracted <- ellmer::parallel_chat_structured(chat, prompts, type = ep_breaks) 



```


```{r Movie Breaks}


big_table[[3]] |> as.list() -> prompts

prompts

mov_breaks <- ellmer::type_object( #create a type thing (used by ellmer)
  #time to record what we want to extract specifically 
  `Pre-roll breaks per movie` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "Extract whether the text contains 'Pre-roll' or 'No pre-roll'.
Rules:
- If the text contains 'No pre-roll', output 'No pre-roll'.
- If the text contains 'Pre-roll', output 'Pre-roll'.
- If both appear, output 'Pre-roll'.
- Ignore all other text."
  ),
  `Minimum breaks per movie` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "Extract the minimum number of breaks during the movie.
Rules:
1. If the text contains 'mid-playback break', set minimum = 0.
2. If the text contains 'long pre-roll break' and no other numbers, set minimum = 0.
3. If the text contains a numeric range 'X to Y breaks', set minimum = X.
4. If the text contains a single number 'X breaks', set minimum = X.
5. If no number appears, return NA.
Examples:
- 'Pre-roll, 6 to 9 breaks during' → 6
- '1 long pre-roll break' → 0
- '1 long pre-roll break or mid-playback break' → 0
- 'Pre-roll, during' → NA", required = FALSE
  ),
  `Maximum breaks per movie` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "Extract the maximum number of breaks during the movie.
Rules:
1. If the text contains 'mid-playback break', set maximum = 1.
2. If the text contains 'long pre-roll break' and no other numbers, set maximum = 0.
3. If the text contains a numeric range 'X to Y breaks', set maximum = Y.
4. If the text contains a single number 'X breaks', set maximum = X.
5. If no number appears, return NA.
Examples:
- 'Pre-roll, 6 to 9 breaks during' → 9
- '1 long pre-roll break' → 0
- '1 long pre-roll break or mid-playback break' → 1
- 'Pre-roll, during' → NA", required = FALSE
  )
)

mov_breaks_extracted <- ellmer::parallel_chat_structured(chat, prompts, type = mov_breaks) 

```


```{r Ad break lengths}
big_table[[4]] |> as.list() -> prompts_tv_len

prompts_tv_len

ad_break_length_tv <- ellmer::type_object( #create a type thing (used by ellmer)
  #time to record what we want to extract specifically 
  `Minimum Ad break length per TV show (seconds)` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "Extract the minimum length of ads in seconds.
Rules:
1. If the text contains a numeric range 'X to Y seconds', set minimum = X.
2. If the text contains a numeric range 'X minutes', set minimum = X * 60.
3. If the text contains a single number 'X seconds', set minimum = X.
Examples:
- '75 to 105 seconds' → 75
- '3 minutes' → 180
- '75 seconds' → 75"
  ),
  `Maximum Ad break length per TV show (seconds)` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "Extract the maximum length of ads in seconds.
Rules:
1. If the text contains a numeric range 'X to Y seconds', set maximum = Y.
2. If the text contains a numeric range 'X minutes', set maximum = X * 60.
3. If the text contains a single number 'X seconds', set maximum = X.
Examples:
- '75 to 105 seconds' → 105
- '3 minutes' → 180
- '75 seconds' → 75"
  )
)

ad_length_tv_extracted <- ellmer::parallel_chat_structured(chat, prompts_tv_len, type = ad_break_length_tv) 



big_table[[5]] |> as.list() -> prompts_mov_len

prompts_mov_len

ad_break_length_mov <- ellmer::type_object( #create a type thing (used by ellmer)
  #time to record what we want to extract specifically 
  `Minimum Ad break length per movie (seconds)` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "Extract the minimum length of ads in seconds.
Rules:
1. If the text contains a numeric range 'X to Y seconds', set minimum = X.
2. If the text contains a numeric range 'X minutes', set minimum = X * 60.
3. If the text contains a numeric range 'X minutes, Y seconds', set minimum = (X * 60) + Y.
4. If the text contains a single number 'X seconds', set minimum = X.
Examples:
- '75 to 105 seconds' → 75
- '3 minutes' → 180
- '75 seconds' → 75
- '2 minutes, 15 seconds' → 135
"
  ),
  `Maximum Ad break length per movie (seconds)` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "Extract the maximum length of ads in seconds.
Rules:
1. If the text contains a numeric range 'X to Y seconds', set maximum = Y.
2. If the text contains a numeric range 'X minutes', set maximum = X * 60.
3. If the text contains a numeric range 'X minutes, Y seconds', set minimum = (X * 60) + Y.
4. If the text contains a single number 'X seconds', set maximum = X.
Examples:
- '75 to 105 seconds' → 105
- '3 minutes' → 180
- '75 seconds' → 75
- '2 minutes, 15 seconds' → 135
"
  )
)

ad_length_mov_extracted <- ellmer::parallel_chat_structured(chat, prompts_mov_len, type = ad_break_length_mov) 
```

```{r}
robotstxt::paths_allowed(
  paths = "resources/most-watched-streaming-service-q4-2025", #The first path after the domain that we want to access
  domain = "https://adwave.com"
  
)


adwave_webpage <- rvest::read_html("https://adwave.com/resources/most-watched-streaming-service-q4-2025")

adwave_webpage |>
  rvest::html_elements("ul > li > p > b") |>
  rvest::html_text() -> streaming

streaming <- streaming[1:9]

streaming

streaming |> as.list() -> prompt_view_share

US_view_share <- ellmer::type_object( 
  `Platform` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "The streaming platform name.
Rules:
1. If the text contains (combined), follow the examples below.
2. If the text contains Streaming, follow the examples below.
3. Otherwise, report the written text as written. 
Examples:
- 'Disney (combined): 4.7%' → Disney+ and Hulu
- 'Paramount Streaming: 2.5%' → Paramount+
- 'Prime Video: 4.3%' → Prime Video
"
  ),
  `Share of total U.S. TV viewing (%)` = ellmer::type_string( 
    description = "Extract the share of total tv viewing.
Rules:
1. If the text contains a numeric value '2.5%', set viewing = 0.025.
2. Change the percentage to a decimal
Examples:
- 'Tubi: 2.0%' → 0.02
- 'Max: 1.8%' → 0.018
"
  )
)

TV_viewing_share <- ellmer::parallel_chat_structured(chat, prompt_view_share, type = US_view_share) 

```

```{r}

global_sub_webpage <- rvest::read_html("https://electroiq.com/stats/streaming-services-statistics/")

global_sub_webpage |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table() -> streaming

global_subs <- streaming[[2]]
global_subs <- global_subs |> select(-c(X2,X3,X5))
colnames(global_subs) <- global_subs[1,]
global_subs <- global_subs[-1,]

global_subs <- global_subs[1:18,]

global_subs$Subscribers <- as.numeric(gsub(" million", "", global_subs$Subscribers))

global_subs <- global_subs |> rename("Platform" = "Service Name")
global_subs <- global_subs |> rename("Subscribers (Millions)" = "Subscribers")

```
